infinite.description: All-in-one management system for beauty centers. Robust appointment, stock, and user control.
infinite.challenge: Digitalizing a complex physical scheduling system to eliminate booking conflicts and centralize service management.
infinite.architecture: Development based on the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern to ensure scalability and clean code maintenance.
infinite.security: Implementation of SEO-friendly routes via .htaccess, sensitive data encryption, and asynchronous session validation.
infinite.database: Normalized relational schema (MySQL) featuring automated triggers for real-time inventory updates after each service.

bookyBloom.description: Interactive digital library built with Kotlin. PDF catalog management and real-time reader community.
bookyBloom.functionality: PDF rendering engine with integrated download capabilities for seamless offline reading.
bookyBloom.stackInfo: Full Firebase integration: Realtime Database for user interaction and Storage for binary file hosting.
bookyBloom.uxui: Native Android interface with full Dark Mode support and Material Design-based navigation.
bookyBloom.roles: Differentiated permission system separating administrative management tools from the end-user reading module.
